body:
Hello @ment0sman 

We have just shipped a beta of [Angular InstantSearch](https://github.com/algolia/angular-instantsearch) that makes it a breeze to use Algolia + Angular!

Give it a try! It takes 5 minutes to build an instant-search example with our [getting started](https://algolia.gitbooks.io/angular-instantsearch/), give me feedback :)

I will update the guide on InstantSearch.js to redirect people to angular-instantsearch 👍
